summary: Nova Minerals Corp filed an 8-K announcing completion of its redomicile to the United States and providing a project update. The filing includes a press release stating that common stock and listed warrants now trade on NYSE American (tickers NVA, NVAWS) and CDIs on ASX. It also reports commencement of antimony and gold drilling at its Stibium and RPM prospects. The filing is a routine corporate update and operational progress report, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are disclosed.
